# Native device picker support bundle

The reported defect is lost selection after the operating-system device dialog closes. The application requires the vendor native picker, an authenticated hardware session and a desktop display. These are unavailable on this host. This bundle has no test runner or native integration harness.

`node diagnose.cjs` checks whether the native picker package can load and reports the actual prerequisite failure. Do not install packages, contact vendor services or construct a mocked dialog to claim the reported behavior is reproduced. The wrapper alone cannot simulate native lifecycle events. Local read-only diagnosis and retained evidence are authorized.
